title: Composition of placements
statement: Let $k,l,m$ be natural numbers, and let a placement from $k$ positions into $l$ positions assign each source position a distinct target position, with a selection map that identifies exactly the source position placed at any given target. Composing a placement from $k$ into $l$ with one from $l$ into $m$ gives the placement whose index map is the composition of the two index maps and whose selection map applies the second selection and then the first.
